automatic_background_selection.policy: bounded two-sided background chosen by withheld-ring measurement
automatic_background_selection.reason: default retained: the source stays bright out to the inner edge of the default band, so no withheld ring of clean background lies in the gap it leaves and no geometry could be measured against it
automatic_background_selection.residual_statistic: 1.4826 x median |(data-sky) sqrt(ivar)| over the input bands and supported rows
automatic_background_selection.holdout_statistic: mean of data minus fitted model over withheld source-free columns between the source wings and the inner band edge; negative means the background is being over-subtracted beside the source
automatic_background_selection.holdout_scope: measures the model error over the ring that was withheld, which is the closest measurable proxy for the unsampled aperture gap; it is not proof that the background under the aperture is known
automatic_background_selection.clean_radius_statistic: larger of a Gaussian core extrapolated to half the profile noise and the radius where the profile stops rising above a local line

automatic_background_selection.residual_statistic: 1.4826 x median |(data-sky) sqrt(ivar)| over the input bands and supported rows
automatic_background_selection.holdout_statistic: mean of data minus fitted model over withheld source-free columns between the source wings and the inner band edge; negative means the background is being over-subtracted beside the source
